newsitem.title: USA: HealthRite to sell unit to Intl Vitamin.
newsitem.headline: HealthRite to sell unit to Intl Vitamin.

text.p: HealthRite Inc said on Thursday that it has agreed to sell its Vitamin Specialties division to IVC Industries Inc for $3.0 million.
Vitamin Specialties is a 15 store retail chain in New Jersey and Philadelphia and has a vitamin mail order catalog service, HealthRite said.

The deal is $1.9 million of cash, plus Vitamin Specialties's inventory value, HealthRite said. The value of the inventory is still being determined, HealthRite President and Chief Executive Brad MacDonald said.
MacDonald said in a phone interview that the company has not determined whether the company would post a gain on the sale.

However, MacDonald said that a "worst case" scenario was that HealthRite would break even on the sale and that a best case was that it would post a gain based on the book value of Vitamin Specialties.
